title: Distribution Group
description: A Distribution Group is a collection of Endpoints that can be grouped together.

guid.description: Unique identifier of the Distribution Group.

createdOn.description: Date and time the Distribution Group was created.

updatedOn.description: Date and time the Distribution Group was last updated.

endpoints.description: List of linked Distribution Group Endpoints.

ApiEndpoint.title: Endpoint

ipAddress.description: External IP address of the Endpoint.

port.description: The port to be configured that is supported by CM. Supported ports: 5060-5100.

priority.description: Determines the Round-Robin order of the endpoint. Each endpoint inside a Distribution Group must have a unique priority.

isActive.description: Determines whether the Endpoint should be active or not.

tlsEnabled.description: Determines whether this endpoint receives SIP traffic via TLS.

ApiEndpoint.description: Endpoint of a Distribution Group where calls can be routed to.
